name: TLD 121 Aircraft Loader
description: High-capacity dual-platform container loader used for rapid loading of palletized cargo into wide-body freighter aircraft.

name: Airport Baggage Truck
description: Essential ground asset for the rapid transit of ULDs and loose baggage carts between the sorting facility and aircraft side.

name: Airport Catering Truck
description: High-lift service vehicle designed to reach aircraft galley doors for replenishing crew supplies and onboard amenities.

name: Ground Power Unit (GPU)
description: Provides external electrical power to aircraft while on the ground, allowing systems to remain active without the APU running.
